### Pride: Don’t Miss the Warning Signs
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-october-24-2017.html
Passage: Daniel 4:27
Points:
- Success and personal pride frequently blind people to the warning signs of an impending collapse.
- God graciously gave Nebuchadnezzar advance notice and clear counsel through Daniel on how to avert disaster.
- Daniel prescribed three specific actions to continue in prosperity: renounce sin, do what is right, and show mercy to the poor.
- Life disruptions such as relationship conflict, repeated temptation, or confusion often serve as loving divine warnings to realign with God.
